title: Psychiatry Weekly: CTE Blood Markers, and the DEA Telemedicine Cliff
description: Two JAMA studies find a plasma tau marker elevated in autopsy-confirmed advanced CTE, but it is not a clinical test. Plus falling overdose deaths, a methadone dose and quality-of-life study, and five weeks left on DEA telemedicine flexibilities.

title: Psychiatry Weekly: Psilocybin NDA and Methadone After Overdose
